question: List the top 3 most populous populated places in each country, ordered by population descending.
sql: SELECT name, country, pop_max FROM (SELECT name, country, pop_max, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY pop_max DESC) AS rn FROM populated_places) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY country, pop_max DESC

question: Give me all major airports ranked by their proximity to the city of London (within 500 km), showing distance in kilometers.
sql: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, l.geometry) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM airports a JOIN populated_places l ON l.name = 'London' WHERE a.type LIKE '%major%' AND ST_DWithin_Sphere(a.geometry, l.geometry, 500000) ORDER BY distance_km

question: Map the largest city (by max population) in each administrative region (admin1) across Canada.
sql: SELECT name, admin1, pop_max, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM (SELECT name, admin1, pop_max, geometry, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admin1 ORDER BY pop_max DESC) AS rn FROM populated_places WHERE iso_a2 = 'CA') WHERE rn = 1

question: Compare the number of airports per type within 100 km of any capital city.
sql: SELECT a.type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM airports a JOIN populated_places p ON ST_DWithin_Sphere(a.geometry, p.geometry, 100000) WHERE p.is_capital = true GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY count DESC

question: Show the cumulative population of world cities ordered from west to east.
sql: SELECT name, ST_X(geometry) AS longitude, pop_max, SUM(pop_max) OVER (ORDER BY ST_X(geometry)) AS cumulative_pop FROM populated_places WHERE is_world_city = true ORDER BY longitude

question: Rank airports by scalerank within each country based on nearby populated places (within 50km).
sql: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, p.country, a.scalerank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.country ORDER BY a.scalerank DESC) AS rank_in_country FROM airports a JOIN populated_places p ON ST_DWithin_Sphere(a.geometry, p.geometry, 50000)
